rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: Before ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy, a landlord or foreclosing owner must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit or Notice of Lease Non-renewal, and must send a copy of that notice together with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the City's Office of Housing Stability.
rules.exemptions: Exempt properties are residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility, and residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug, or other substance abuse.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day, enforced by the Inspectional Services Department. A violation of the Ordinance does not halt the eviction process.

rules.conflict_note: This is a notice/procedural requirement, not a substantive just-cause standard for eviction; Boston does not otherwise require 'just cause' to end a tenancy under this document.
